patch.value: Identity refusal reads only top-level fields, so a runtime field mapped onto comments, notes, learnings or dependencies can store a nested author with URL userinfo

Found by the CodeRabbit review of PR 1712 (pm-gh1707). assertIdentityFieldsWithoutUrlCredentials checks the top-level author, assignee and claim_principal of create metadata and runtime update values. A runtime field definition may set metadata_key to a built-in collection such as comments, notes, learnings or dependencies, and an array field without a value_schema stores its JSON as-is, so a nested entry's author can carry URL userinfo past the guard. Fix: walk nested arrays and objects of the checked values (bounded depth) for identity keys, or reject built-in collection keys as runtime metadata_key during field normalization.

A runtime or registered field value whose nested entries carry an author, assignee or claim_principal with URL userinfo is refused like a top-level one; Ordinary nested collections without credentials are unaffected; A regression test covers a runtime array field mapped onto comments
No field path can store an identity carrying URL userinfo
Nested authors in runtime collection fields bypass the identity refusal
